title: House Robber
prompt: You are a robber planning to rob houses along a street, represented by an array `nums` where `nums[i]` is the money in house `i`. You cannot rob two adjacent houses (it triggers an alarm). Return the maximum amount you can rob.
hints: At each house, you either rob it (skip the previous one) or skip it and keep the best total so far.
Track two running values: best total if you stop before the previous house, and best total including it.
This can be done in O(1) space without an explicit DP array.
